LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_Description: Set target stocks for six components. All planning desks share this map's plan. Deficits add 1/5/10-piece bills to existing suitable machines; workers need the usual materials, research and power. Manual bills and unfinished batches count toward pending output. A target of 0 disables that product.
LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_Status: Unstarted surplus orders are removed when stock arrives or targets fall. An already-started batch finishes. Removing the last desk or disabling planning pauses its bills and preserves unfinished work.
